name: shipment-web-styles
description: Tailwind CSS build of the Blazor front and the vendored Leaflet (wwwroot/lib/leaflet, committed) - no JavaScript bundle. Run through MSBuild (Shipment.Api.csproj); npm run vendor:leaflet after a Leaflet upgrade.

scripts.vendor:leaflet: rm -rf wwwroot/lib/leaflet && mkdir -p wwwroot/lib/leaflet && cp node_modules/leaflet/dist/leaflet.js node_modules/leaflet/dist/leaflet.css node_modules/leaflet/LICENSE wwwroot/lib/leaflet/
